text: Vinci's own shareholder page shows a spread shareholding: at 31 December 2025 individual shareholders held 11.6% of the capital, alongside group employees, treasury shares and about 1,000 institutional investors.

source.name: Vinci SA — Becoming a shareholder (shareholder page)
source.quote: At 31 December 2025, individual shareholders represented 11.6% of VINCI’s capital.
